package pay

// @provenance rule: rule_struct
type Payroll struct {
	Hours int
}

// @provenance rule: rule_method
func (p *Payroll) Pays() bool {
	return p.Hours > 38
}

// @provenance rule: rule_interface
type Rates interface {
	Rate() int
}

// @provenance rule: rule_generic_func
func Max[T int | float64](items []T) T {
	return items[0]
}

// @provenance rule: rule_type_group
type (
	Ledger struct{}
)

func Later() {}

// @provenance rule: rule_var
var Limit = 38

func AfterVar() {}

func body() {
	// @provenance rule: rule_literal_result
	func() error { return nil }()
	// @provenance rule: rule_literal_parameter
	func(x int) int { return x }(3)
	// @provenance rule: rule_literal_func_result
	func(x int) func() int { return nil }(3)
	run(
		// @provenance rule: rule_call_argument
		func() {},
	)
}

// @provenance rule: rule_function
func Pays(hours int) bool {
	return hours > 38
}
